---
name: Feature request / 改进建议
about: Suggest a focused improvement to the local workbench.
---

## What do you want to do? / 想完成什么？

## What should change? / 希望怎样改？

## How can we verify it? / 怎样验收？

If the change would read or write additional data, describe what data and where it would go. Use fictional examples.
